description: SSEN Transmission, the transmission owner for the north of Scotland, publishes 69 datasets on an Opendatasoft portal with a data catalogue, data request form, glossary, FAQs and API guidance, read on 2026-09-26. Datasets read include shapefiles of 120 grid substation sites and 42 supergrid substation sites with name and voltage, and yearly indexes of SSEN Transmission substation codes used in the Electricity Ten Year Statement (ETYS) for 2022 to 2025, each with between 417 and 455 entries. Style sheets are provided in the export tab. Data are under CC BY 4.0 and free, but the portal asks users to register or log in to view or download them. Caveats: the yearly code indexes overlap heavily, so the latest year is usually enough, and site polygons do not include line routes. Simulation uses are locating transmission substations for network flow models and hazard exposure studies of the Highlands grid. Related records: data-sp-energy-networks-open-data-portal covers distribution in southern Scotland.
